I have put together a short free-time page for attendees of the 32nd Annual Meeting of the Japanese Association for Disaster Medicine (March 18-20, 2027, Sapporo Convention Center). Could you please review it and let me know if you would like any changes before it goes live?

Thank you, and best regards
